final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS f, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS a, COUNT(*) AS c FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.f AS f, s1.a AS a, s1.c AS c, s1.c - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c > s2.m) SELECT AVG(a), SUM(c), AVG(d) FROM s3
